definitions.comparison: Canonical fixed recipe, source, manager side and lineup are checked; each variant is compared only with its corresponding baseline subset, not the full100 aggregate.
definitions.tactics: Own attack metrics describe orientation/tempo. Opponent pressure/chance and own keeper metrics describe changed own defence. Score alone cannot prove the intended tactical mechanism.
definitions.capability: Variants alter cloned existing capability attributes, preserving real source data and CA/PA. RUNNER is a composite speed/agility/explosiveness/endurance contrast; PASSER includes handling/read/composure. Whole-match responses include physical feedback and CPU coaching, not isolated shot probability.
definitions.lineup: If actual starting IDs/roles changed, startingLineupsIdentical is false and this must not be described as an isolated same-lineup attribute experiment.
definitions.statistics: Each row preserves mean/median/p10/p90/range plus paired change. Deterministic finite seed contrasts are not an empirical league census or evidence that every strong player wins every seed.
definitions.energy: Final energy includes actual minutes and substitutions; compare court-time/load alongside it. No attribution of universal second-half collapse is made from energy alone.
